issue summary: Home - Banner image is missing alternative text
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Navigate to the Home page. 2) Inspect the hero banner image with a screen reader. Actual: Screen reader announces "image" with no description. Expected: Screen reader should announce meaningful alt text describing the promotion (e.g., "Fall boot sale, up to 40% off").

issue summary: Home - New Arrivals carousel has no pause control
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Load the Home page. 2) Observe the "New Arrivals" carousel. Actual: Carousel auto-rotates every 4 seconds with no way to pause, stop, or hide it. Expected: A visible pause/stop control should be provided.

issue summary: Global Header - Skip to main content link missing
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Load any page. 2) Press Tab as the first action. Actual: Focus moves directly to the search field; there is no way to skip repeated navigation links. Expected: A "Skip to main content" link should be the first focusable element on the page.

issue summary: Global Header - Hamburger menu button has no accessible name
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Resize browser to mobile width. 2) Use a screen reader to navigate to the menu icon. Actual: Screen reader announces "button" with no label. Expected: Button should announce "Open menu" or similar.

issue summary: Global Header - Focus indicator invisible on nav links
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Tab through the header navigation using keyboard only. Actual: No visible focus outline appears on the "Shoes", "Toys", or "Propane" nav links. Expected: A visible focus indicator meeting contrast requirements should appear on every focusable element.

issue summary: Search Results - Search input missing associated label
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Navigate to the search bar in the header. 2) Inspect it with a screen reader. Actual: Input announces only as "edit text" with no label. Expected: Input should have a programmatically associated label such as "Search Acme Shoes, Toys, and Propane".

issue summary: Search Results - Filter checkboxes not keyboard operable
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Perform a search. 2) Tab to the "Filter by Brand" checkboxes. 3) Press Space. Actual: Custom-styled checkboxes cannot be toggled with the keyboard, only with a mouse click. Expected: Checkboxes should respond to the Space key like native controls.

issue summary: Search Results - "No results found" message not announced
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Search for a term with no matches. Actual: The message appears visually but screen reader users are not notified. Expected: Message should be placed in a live region so it is announced automatically.

issue summary: Product Listing - Sale price conveyed by color alone
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Navigate to the Toys category. 2) Observe discounted items. Actual: Sale price is shown only in red text with no other indicator. Expected: A text label such as "Sale" or a strikethrough on the original price should also be present.

issue summary: Product Listing - Grid/list view toggle icons lack labels
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Navigate to the Shoes category. 2) Use a screen reader on the view-toggle icons. Actual: Buttons announce as "button, button" with no distinguishing text. Expected: Buttons should announce "Grid view" and "List view".

issue summary: Product Listing - Sort dropdown does not announce selected option
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Open the "Sort by" dropdown. 2) Select "Price: Low to High". Actual: Screen reader does not confirm the newly selected sort order. Expected: The selection change should be announced.

issue summary: Product Listing - Insufficient color contrast on Add to Cart button
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Navigate to the Propane Accessories category. 2) Inspect the "Add to Cart" button text color. Actual: Light gray text (#999999) on a white background measures a 2.8:1 contrast ratio. Expected: Contrast should be at least 4.5:1 for normal text.

issue summary: Product Detail Page - Image gallery thumbnails missing alt text
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Open a shoe product page. 2) Tab through the thumbnail images. Actual: Screen reader announces "image, image, image" for all thumbnails. Expected: Each thumbnail should describe the view shown (e.g., "Side view", "Sole view").

issue summary: Product Detail Page - Size selector shows out-of-stock by color only
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Open a shoe product page with limited sizes in stock. Actual: Out-of-stock sizes are grayed out with no text indication. Expected: "Out of stock" should be conveyed via text or an accessible disabled state, not color alone.

issue summary: Product Detail Page - Image zoom overlay traps keyboard focus
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Click a product image to open the zoom overlay. 2) Press Tab repeatedly, then press Escape. Actual: Focus is trapped inside the zoom overlay with no way to exit via keyboard; Escape does not close it. Expected: Escape should close the overlay and return focus to the trigger element.

issue summary: Product Detail Page - Star rating widget not announced correctly
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Navigate to the review summary with a screen reader. Actual: Star rating is announced as a string of image icons with no rating value. Expected: Rating should announce as text, e.g., "Rated 4.2 out of 5 stars".

issue summary: Product Detail Page - Add to Cart success message not announced
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Click "Add to Cart" on any product. Actual: A toast confirms the item was added, but screen reader users receive no notification. Expected: Confirmation should be placed in an ARIA live region.

issue summary: Product Detail Page - Video demo has no captions
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Open a toy product page with an embedded demo video. 2) Play the video. Actual: No captions are available. Expected: Captions should be provided for all prerecorded video with audio.

issue summary: Product Detail Page - Heading levels skip from H1 to H4
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Inspect the heading structure on any product page. Actual: Page goes from H1 (product name) directly to H4 (specifications), skipping H2 and H3. Expected: Heading levels should not skip, to aid navigation for screen reader users.

issue summary: Shopping Cart - Quantity stepper buttons too small for touch
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Open the cart on a touchscreen device. 2) Attempt to tap the "+" quantity button. Actual: Button target measures approximately 18x18px, making accurate activation difficult. Expected: Touch targets should be at least 24x24 CSS pixels.

issue summary: Shopping Cart - Remove item link text not descriptive
description: Steps to recreate: 1) View the cart with multiple items. 2) Tab to the "Remove" links. Actual: All links say only "Remove" with no product context, which is ambiguous for screen reader users browsing by a links list. Expected: Link should include the product name, e.g., "Remove Acme Trail Runner, Size 10".

issue summary: Shopping Cart - Updated subtotal not announced after quantity change
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Change an item's quantity in the cart. Actual: Subtotal updates visually but is not announced to screen reader users. Expected: The updated total should be placed in a live region.

issue summary: Checkout - Form fields missing visible labels
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Navigate to the shipping address form. 2) Inspect fields with a screen reader. Actual: Fields rely on placeholder text only ("Street Address"), which disappears on input and is not a substitute for a label. Expected: Persistent, visible labels should be associated with each field.

issue summary: Checkout - Error messages not linked to invalid fields
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Submit the checkout form with an invalid email address. Actual: Error text appears at the top of the form but is not programmatically associated with the email field. Expected: Error should be linked via aria-describedby and the field should have aria-invalid="true".

issue summary: Checkout - Session times out with no warning
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Begin checkout and remain idle for 10 minutes. Actual: Session expires and the cart is cleared with no warning. Expected: User should be warned before timeout and given the option to extend the session.

issue summary: Checkout - Payment form fields lack autocomplete attributes
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Inspect the payment form fields in the DOM. Actual: Name, address, and card fields lack autocomplete attributes. Expected: Fields should use appropriate autocomplete values (e.g., "cc-number") to support autofill and identify input purpose.

issue summary: Checkout - Progress step indicator relies on color only
description: Steps to recreate: 1) View the checkout step indicator (Shipping / Payment / Review). Actual: Current step is shown only by a highlighted color; no text or icon differentiates it. Expected: Current step should also use text (e.g., "Step 2 of 3, current") or a distinct icon.

issue summary: Checkout - Order confirmation modal not announced
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Complete an order. 2) Confirmation modal appears. Actual: Focus does not move into the modal and the screen reader does not announce it. Expected: Focus should move to the modal and its content should be announced.

issue summary: Account - Show/hide password toggle has no accessible name
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Navigate to the login page. 2) Tab to the "show password" eye icon. Actual: Screen reader announces "button" only. Expected: Button should announce "Show password" / "Hide password" state.

issue summary: Account - Two-factor authentication code input has no label
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Trigger 2FA during login. 2) Inspect the 6-digit code input. Actual: Input has no associated label, only a placeholder. Expected: Input should have a programmatic label such as "Enter 6-digit verification code".

issue summary: Account - Order history table missing header associations
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Navigate to Order History. 2) Use a screen reader to read table cells. Actual: Cell values (date, order number, total) are read without their column headers. Expected: Table headers should use <th scope="col"> so cells are announced with context.

issue summary: Account - Edit and delete icons on address book have identical labels
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Navigate to Manage Addresses. 2) Inspect the icon buttons with a screen reader. Actual: Both buttons announce as "button" with no distinguishing text. Expected: Buttons should have unique accessible names, e.g., "Edit Home address", "Delete Home address".

issue summary: Footer - Social media links give no warning they open a new tab
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Tab to the Instagram icon link in the footer. 2) Activate it. Actual: Link opens a new browser tab with no advance notice to the user. Expected: Link purpose/behavior should be made clear before activation, e.g., through link text or an accessible warning.

issue summary: Footer - Newsletter signup email field missing label
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Scroll to the footer newsletter signup. 2) Inspect the email input. Actual: Input has a placeholder "Enter email" only, with no programmatic label. Expected: Field should have an associated <label> or aria-label.

issue summary: Footer - Low contrast copyright and legal links
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Inspect the footer legal links (Privacy Policy, Terms). Actual: Light gray text (#B0B0B0) on a dark background measures 2.1:1 contrast. Expected: Text contrast should meet 4.5:1 minimum.

issue summary: Global - Page language not declared in HTML
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Inspect page source across the site. Actual: The <html> tag has no lang attribute. Expected: lang="en" should be set so screen readers apply correct pronunciation rules.

issue summary: Global - Duplicate id attributes break label associations
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Inspect the DOM on the Home page. Actual: Multiple elements share id="cta-button", causing label associations to break for screen reader users. Expected: All id attributes should be unique on the page.

issue summary: Global - Content does not reflow at 400% zoom
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Set browser zoom to 400%. 2) Browse the Shoes category page. Actual: Content requires horizontal scrolling in two dimensions; the product grid overflows the viewport. Expected: Content should reflow to a single column, requiring only vertical scrolling.

issue summary: Global - Text cannot be resized to 200% without loss of content
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Increase browser text size to 200% via zoom. 2) Browse the Account page. Actual: Navigation menu text overlaps and some labels are cut off. Expected: Content should remain readable and functional at 200% text size.

issue summary: Global - Live chat widget traps keyboard focus
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Open the live chat widget via keyboard. 2) Tab through the widget, then attempt to Tab out. Actual: Focus cannot leave the chat widget once opened; Escape does not close it. Expected: Users should be able to close the widget and return focus without becoming trapped.

issue summary: iOS App Home - Promotional banner image not labeled for VoiceOver
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Open the app and enable VoiceOver. 2) Swipe to the hero banner. Actual: VoiceOver announces "image" with no description. Expected: Image should have an accessibility label describing the promotion.

issue summary: iOS App Home - Tab bar icons missing accessible labels
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable VoiceOver. 2) Swipe through the bottom tab bar (Home, Search, Cart, Account). Actual: Tabs announce only "button" or "tab" with no name. Expected: Each tab should announce its name and selected state, e.g., "Home, tab, 1 of 4, selected".

issue summary: iOS App Home - Category cards skipped in VoiceOver swipe order
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable VoiceOver. 2) Swipe right through the Home screen. Actual: Focus order jumps from the header directly to the footer, skipping the "Shop by Category" cards entirely. Expected: All interactive category cards should be reachable in a logical swipe order.

issue summary: iOS App Search - Search field not announced as a search field
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable VoiceOver. 2) Navigate to the search input. Actual: Field is announced generically as "text field" rather than indicating its search purpose. Expected: Field should use the search field trait so VoiceOver announces "Search field".

issue summary: iOS App Search - Recent searches list items unlabeled
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Perform searches, then reopen the search screen. 2) Swipe through "Recent Searches". Actual: Each row announces as "button" with no search term text. Expected: Row should announce the search term, e.g., "hiking boots, recent search".

issue summary: iOS App PDP - Image carousel gives no VoiceOver swipe instructions or position
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable VoiceOver. 2) Focus the product image carousel. Actual: No hint indicates that swiping changes images, and focus does not announce position (e.g., "1 of 5"). Expected: Carousel should announce position and provide adjustable swipe hints.

issue summary: iOS App PDP - Size selector buttons do not announce selected state
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable VoiceOver. 2) Select a shoe size. Actual: VoiceOver does not announce that the size button is now selected. Expected: Selected state should be conveyed, e.g., "Size 9, selected".

issue summary: iOS App PDP - Dynamic Type not supported on product description
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Increase text size in iOS Settings > Accessibility > Display & Text Size to the largest setting. 2) Open a product page. Actual: Product description text does not scale and remains a fixed small size, becoming difficult to read. Expected: Text should respect the user's Dynamic Type preference.

issue summary: iOS App PDP - Add to Cart button has insufficient touch target size
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Open a product page. 2) Attempt to tap the "Add to Cart" button. Actual: Button hit area measures approximately 30x30pt. Expected: Interactive targets should be at least 24x24 CSS pixels (WCAG minimum; 44x44pt recommended by iOS HIG).

issue summary: iOS App PDP - Color swatches identified by color only
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Open a shoe product with multiple color options. 2) Enable VoiceOver and swipe to the color swatches. Actual: Swatches announce only "button" with no color name. Expected: Each swatch should announce the color name, e.g., "Forest Green, button".

issue summary: iOS App Cart - Swipe-to-delete gesture has no alternative
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Open Cart. 2) Attempt to remove an item using VoiceOver. Actual: Only a swipe gesture on the row reveals a delete button; no standalone, always-visible remove control exists as an alternative. Expected: A standalone "Remove item" button/action should be available.

issue summary: iOS App Cart - Cart badge count update not announced
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Add an item to the cart from the PDP. 2) Return to the tab bar. Actual: Cart tab badge updates visually (e.g., "1") but VoiceOver does not announce the change. Expected: Update should be announced via an accessibility notification.

issue summary: iOS App Checkout - Form field errors not announced
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Submit the checkout form with a missing required field. Actual: Error text appears below the field visually, but VoiceOver focus does not move to it and it is not announced. Expected: Error should be announced immediately and focus should move to the first invalid field.

issue summary: iOS App Checkout - Face ID authentication overlay has no accessible status
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Reach payment confirmation. 2) Trigger the Face ID prompt. Actual: Custom overlay shown during the Face ID scan has no VoiceOver label describing what is happening. Expected: Overlay should announce "Authenticating with Face ID" or similar status.

issue summary: iOS App Checkout - Order summary values missing labels for VoiceOver
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable VoiceOver. 2) Swipe through the order summary (subtotal, shipping, tax, total). Actual: Each value is a separate element read as just a number, e.g., "$12.99", with no context. Expected: Each value should include its label, e.g., "Shipping, $12.99".

issue summary: iOS App Account - Password field does not announce as secure or labeled
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable VoiceOver. 2) Focus the password field on the login screen. Actual: Field announces as "text field" without indicating it is a secure entry, and has no visible label. Expected: Field should announce "Password, secure text field".

issue summary: iOS App Account - Settings toggle switches don't confirm state change
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable VoiceOver. 2) Toggle the "Order Update Notifications" switch. Actual: Switch activates but VoiceOver does not reliably confirm the new on/off state. Expected: State change should be reliably announced.

issue summary: iOS App Account - Profile photo upload button unlabeled
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable VoiceOver. 2) Navigate to the profile photo edit button. Actual: Announces only "button". Expected: Should announce "Change profile photo, button".

issue summary: iOS App Navigation - Filter modal does not move VoiceOver focus on open
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Open the product filters modal. Actual: VoiceOver focus remains on the underlying page; the modal's presence and content are not announced. Expected: Focus should move to the modal heading when it opens.

issue summary: iOS App Navigation - Back button announces generically with no destination
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable VoiceOver. 2) Navigate into a subcategory, then focus the back button. Actual: Back button announces simply as "button" rather than indicating destination or action. Expected: Should announce "Back to Shoes, button" or similar.

issue summary: iOS App Notifications - Notification permission pre-screen has poor contrast
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Trigger the custom "enable notifications" pre-permission screen. 2) Inspect the button colors. Actual: "Allow" button text is light gray (#AAAAAA) on white, contrast ratio approximately 2.3:1. Expected: Should meet 4.5:1 minimum contrast for text.

issue summary: iOS App Settings - Large text sizes truncate tab bar labels
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Set the largest Dynamic Type size. 2) View the bottom tab bar. Actual: Labels like "Account" are visually truncated to "Acc..." with no way to access the full text. Expected: Layout should adapt, e.g., stacking or scrolling, to preserve full readable labels.

issue summary: iOS App Settings - Reduce Motion preference not respected in transitions
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable "Reduce Motion" in iOS Accessibility settings. 2) Navigate between screens in the app. Actual: App continues to use large parallax/zoom animations regardless of the setting. Expected: App should honor Reduce Motion and use simpler cross-fade transitions.

issue summary: iOS App Global - Loading spinner has no accessible status
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Trigger any content load (e.g., search results). 2) Enable VoiceOver during loading. Actual: Spinner is visually shown but VoiceOver gives no indication content is loading. Expected: A "Loading" status should be announced via an accessibility notification.

issue summary: iOS App Global - Star rating icons unlabeled on review cards
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable VoiceOver. 2) Navigate to a product review card. Actual: Five star icons are announced individually as "image, image..." with no rating summary. Expected: Rating should be summarized as one accessible element, e.g., "4 out of 5 stars".

issue summary: iOS App Global - Price range slider not operable via VoiceOver
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Open the price filter. 2) Enable VoiceOver and attempt to adjust the slider using the adjustable swipe up/down gesture. Actual: Slider does not respond to VoiceOver's increment/decrement gestures. Expected: Slider should implement the adjustable trait and respond to swipe up/down to change value.

issue summary: iOS App Global - Bold Text system setting not supported
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable "Bold Text" in iOS Accessibility settings. 2) Restart the app and browse. Actual: Text throughout the app remains regular weight, not respecting the system-wide setting. Expected: App should render text with bold weight when the system setting is enabled.

issue summary: iOS App Global - Alert dialogs missing accessible dialog role
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Trigger the "Are you sure you want to sign out?" alert. 2) Enable VoiceOver. Actual: Alert content is read but not identified as a dialog, so users are not aware focus is contained within it. Expected: Alert should be presented with proper dialog semantics.

issue summary: iOS App Global - Landscape orientation not supported
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Rotate the device to landscape while browsing the app. Actual: App forces portrait orientation, restricting users who need landscape for mounted device or switch access setups. Expected: Content should be operable in both orientations unless a specific orientation is essential.

issue summary: iOS App Global - Wishlist heart toggle doesn't announce state
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable VoiceOver. 2) Tap the heart icon on a product card to add it to the wishlist. Actual: Button re-renders visually (filled heart) but VoiceOver still announces "button" without indicating it is now selected. Expected: Button should announce updated state, e.g., "Remove from wishlist, button, selected".

issue summary: Android App Home - Hero banner image not labeled for TalkBack
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable TalkBack. 2) Swipe to the hero banner on the Home screen. Actual: TalkBack announces "unlabeled image". Expected: Image should include a contentDescription describing the promotion.

issue summary: Android App Home - Bottom navigation tabs missing selected state
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable TalkBack. 2) Swipe to the bottom navigation tabs. Actual: TalkBack does not indicate which tab is currently selected. Expected: Selected tab should announce "selected", e.g., "Home, tab, selected".

issue summary: Android App Home - Category grid items in illogical TalkBack reading order
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable TalkBack. 2) Swipe through the "Shop by Category" grid. Actual: Reading order jumps diagonally across the grid rather than row by row, confusing navigation. Expected: Reading order should follow a logical left-to-right, top-to-bottom sequence.

issue summary: Android App Search - Voice search microphone button unlabeled
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable TalkBack. 2) Swipe to the microphone icon in the search bar. Actual: Announces as "button" only. Expected: Should announce "Voice search, button".

issue summary: Android App Search - Filter chips do not announce selected state
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable TalkBack. 2) Select a "Brand: Acme" filter chip. Actual: TalkBack does not confirm the chip is now active/selected. Expected: Chip should announce state changes, e.g., "Brand: Acme, selected".

issue summary: Android App PDP - Image gallery lacks position announcement
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable TalkBack. 2) Swipe through the product images. Actual: TalkBack does not announce image position (e.g., "2 of 6"). Expected: Position should be included so users understand how many images remain.

issue summary: Android App PDP - Size selector buttons too small for touch
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Open a shoe product page. 2) Measure the size selector button hit area. Actual: Buttons measure approximately 32x32dp with tight spacing. Expected: Touch targets should be at least 24x24 CSS pixels minimum (48x48dp recommended by Material Design).

issue summary: Android App PDP - Font scaling ignored when system font size increased
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Increase font size in Android Settings > Display > Font size to maximum. 2) Open a product description. Actual: Text remains a fixed size and does not scale with the system setting. Expected: Text should scale with the user's font size preference.

issue summary: Android App PDP - Color options identified by swatch only, no text name
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable TalkBack. 2) Swipe to the color swatches on a product. Actual: Swatches announce as "button" with no color name given. Expected: Should announce the color name, e.g., "Charcoal Gray, button".

issue summary: Android App PDP - Add to Cart Snackbar dismisses before TalkBack finishes
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Tap "Add to Cart". 2) Observe the Snackbar confirmation duration while using TalkBack. Actual: Snackbar disappears after 2 seconds, before TalkBack finishes announcing the message. Expected: Timed content should allow sufficient time or remain accessible/dismissible for assistive technology users.

issue summary: Android App Cart - Quantity stepper buttons lack accessible labels
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable TalkBack. 2) Swipe to the +/- quantity buttons in the cart. Actual: Both buttons announce simply as "button". Expected: Should announce "Increase quantity" and "Decrease quantity" respectively.

issue summary: Android App Cart - Swipe-to-remove gesture has no accessible alternative
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable TalkBack. 2) Attempt to remove a cart item. Actual: Only a swipe gesture on the row triggers removal; no standalone remove action is exposed. Expected: A discoverable remove action should exist independent of the swipe gesture.

issue summary: Android App Cart - Empty cart illustration missing content description
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Empty the cart. 2) Enable TalkBack and swipe to the illustration. Actual: Announces "unlabeled image". Expected: Purely decorative images should be marked so TalkBack skips them, or given a meaningful description if informative.

issue summary: Android App Checkout - Required field indicators not announced
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable TalkBack. 2) Navigate to the required "Phone Number" field. Actual: A visual asterisk indicates the field is required, but TalkBack does not announce this. Expected: Field should announce as "required".

issue summary: Android App Checkout - Error banner not announced on validation failure
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Submit checkout with an invalid ZIP code. Actual: A red error banner appears at the top of the screen but TalkBack focus does not move there and it is not announced. Expected: Error should be announced immediately, and focus should move to it or the first invalid field.

issue summary: Android App Checkout - Payment method radio group missing label
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable TalkBack. 2) Swipe through the payment method options (Credit Card, PayPal, Acme Pay). Actual: Each option is announced individually with no group heading indicating "Choose payment method". Expected: Radio group should have an accessible group label/heading.

issue summary: Android App Checkout - Order total breakdown read in reversed order
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable TalkBack. 2) Swipe through the order summary. Actual: Reading order is Total, Tax, Subtotal, Shipping, which is reversed from the visual top-to-bottom order, confusing users. Expected: Reading order should match the visual/logical order.

issue summary: Android App Account - Sign in with Google button loses label on small screens
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable TalkBack. 2) Navigate to the social sign-in buttons on a small-width device. Actual: Button collapses to icon-only and loses its accessible label. Expected: Accessible name should be retained regardless of visual layout changes.

issue summary: Android App Account - Biometric login toggle doesn't indicate current state
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable TalkBack. 2) Navigate to the "Use fingerprint to log in" switch. Actual: TalkBack announces the control but not whether it is currently on or off. Expected: Switch should announce its checked state.

issue summary: Android App Account - Address form missing autofill hints
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Inspect the address form fields in code or with an autofill service active. Actual: Fields lack android:autofillHints attributes (e.g., postalAddress, postalCode). Expected: Appropriate autofill hints should be set to support autofill services and identify input purpose.

issue summary: Android App Navigation - Custom back gesture conflicts with system back, no alternative
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable TalkBack. 2) Attempt to navigate back from the Filter screen using the system back gesture. Actual: Custom in-app gesture intercepts and does not close the screen as expected; no visible back button alternative exists. Expected: A standard, discoverable back control should always be available alongside gesture navigation.

issue summary: Android App Navigation - Bottom sheet filter modal doesn't receive initial TalkBack focus
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Open the "Sort & Filter" bottom sheet. Actual: TalkBack focus stays on the underlying product list; the sheet's presence is not announced. Expected: Focus should move to the bottom sheet heading when it appears.

issue summary: Android App Notifications - Order status notification and controls have vague labels
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Trigger an order status update notification. Actual: Notification reads only "Update available" with no specifics, and its expand/collapse control also lacks a label for TalkBack users. Expected: Notification content and controls should have clear, descriptive labels.

issue summary: Android App Settings - Large text/display size causes overlapping UI in Account screen
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable Android's largest font size and display size settings. 2) Open the Account screen. Actual: Menu item labels overlap their icons and adjacent text. Expected: Layout should adapt without overlapping content at large text/display sizes.

issue summary: Android App Global - Loading progress bar has no accessible label or state
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable TalkBack. 2) Trigger a page load (e.g., applying filters). Actual: Progress bar is visually shown but is not announced or exposed with an accessible progress role. Expected: Loading state should be announced to TalkBack users.

issue summary: Android App Global - Star rating not summarized as a single accessible element
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable TalkBack. 2) Swipe to a product card's star rating. Actual: Announces five separate "image" elements with no summary text. Expected: Should be combined into one element announcing, e.g., "Rated 4.5 out of 5 stars, 213 reviews".

issue summary: Android App Global - Price range slider unresponsive to TalkBack adjust gestures
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable TalkBack. 2) Focus the price range slider in filters. 3) Swipe up/down to adjust the value. Actual: Slider does not change value in response to TalkBack's adjustment gestures. Expected: Slider should implement adjustable accessibility actions so TalkBack swipe up/down works.

issue summary: Android App Global - Dark theme secondary text has insufficient contrast
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable system dark theme. 2) Inspect secondary/muted text (e.g., product subtitle) against the dark background. Actual: Gray text (#6E6E6E) on near-black background (#121212) measures approximately 3.1:1. Expected: Contrast should meet 4.5:1 minimum for normal text.

issue summary: Android App Global - Wishlist heart toggle lacks state announcement
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Enable TalkBack. 2) Tap the heart icon on a product card. Actual: Icon visually fills in but TalkBack still announces a generic "button" without indicating it is now selected/added. Expected: Should announce updated state, e.g., "Added to wishlist, button, selected".

issue summary: Android App Global - Orientation lock prevents landscape use
description: Steps to recreate: 1) Rotate the device to landscape while using the app. Actual: App forces portrait mode regardless of device rotation, restricting users who rely on a fixed mounted landscape orientation (e.g., wheelchair-mounted tablets). Expected: Content should support both orientations unless a specific orientation is essential.
